stem: Which line from the play shows that Ben wants to improve?

options.label: A
options.text: BEN: No time. I’ve got to finish this before— (line 9)

options.label: B
options.text: BEN: [Shrugs.] I’m not very good at time management. (line 22)

options.label: C
options.text: BEN: My solar system project! [He frowns.] Mr. Nodiff was not impressed. (line 30)

options.label: D
options.text: BEN: I will! I promise! [Pauses.] Can you show me that trick for multiplying by nine? (line 42)
